messages.author: Antigravity
messages.content: Welcome to **hellyeah** (`v0.1.0 — Genesis`). Tell me what you want this app to become, or pick one of the evolution suggestions.

messages.author: You (via iPhone Bridge #1)
messages.content: Move chat window to the top

messages.author: Antigravity
messages.content:
Received your iPhone prompt (`Issue #1`) and evolved **hellyeah** to `v0.2.0`:

- **Moved the Evolution Chat Console (`#antigravity-console`) to the very top** of the workspace (`index.html` & `style.css`), directly above the Live Application Stage in all modes (`mode-genesis` and `mode-evolved`).
- Placed the **Prompt Input Box** and **Suggested Evolutions** right in the top console so they are immediately accessible on your iPhone without scrolling.
messages.mutationBadge: v0.2.0 • Moved Chat Window to Top (#1)

suggestions.title: Personal Command Deck & Pomodoro Studio
suggestions.description: Add a tactile focus timer and daily intent queue directly below the top chat window.
suggestions.prompt: Evolve the stage into a Personal Command Deck with a tactile Pomodoro focus timer and task queue.

suggestions.title: Interactive Synth & Touch XY Audio Pad
suggestions.description: Add a playable WebAudio polyphonic XY pad with iPhone touch expression below the chat.
suggestions.prompt: Add a playable WebAudio synthesizer and XY expression pad with preset chords.

suggestions.title: Collapsible Compact Chat Mode
suggestions.description: Add a 1-tap toggle to collapse/expand the chat history and suggestions tray on iPhone.
suggestions.prompt: Add a 1-tap collapse/expand toggle to the top chat window so I can minimize chat history when using the stage.

suggestions.title: Live Markdown & Idea Graph Scratchpad
suggestions.description: Create interconnected thought cards that persist on your device.
suggestions.prompt: Build an interactive spatial note-taking board where I can create and link thought cards.

changelog.summary: Moved Evolution Chat Console (#antigravity-console) and prompt input to the top of the app across all modes.
Initialized hellyeah core with SSE hot-reload, Antigravity file-bridge, suggestion engine, and modular stage.
